subject: scenario_sdsc
policy: Reference photographs are cited here, never committed. They are CC BY / CC BY-SA / GFDL works: share-alike conflicts with the CC BY 4.0 this project's assets ship under, and CC BY would require carrying the credit inside the file. This manifest records URL, author, licence and date for every one of them so the survey can be reproduced. Re-download them with `python3 refs_fetch.py scenario_sdsc` from the repository root; check the rule is holding with `python3 refs_fetch.py --verificar`. See NOTICE.md and sdsc_references.md.
